Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련 중 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 코에서 피가 터졌다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: During training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> suddenly got a nosebleed. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN:
トレーニング中、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が鼻血を出してしまった。
何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在训练途中流了鼻血，该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在訓練途中流了鼻血，該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pendant l'entraînement, le nez de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est mis à saigner. Que dois-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Während des Trainings bekam <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> plötzlich Nasenbluten. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Durante el entrenamiento, a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> le brotó sangre de la nariz. ¿Qué debería decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Durante o treino, o nariz de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sangrou de repente. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ระหว่างการฝึกซ้อม <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> มีเลือดกำเดาไหลออกมา คุณจะพูดว่าอะไรดี?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Selama latihan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tiba-tiba mimisan. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trong lúc luyện tập, máu đã chảy từ mũi của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण के दौरान, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को अचानक नकसीर आ गई। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Non, aujourd'hui, je dois me reposer.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Okay. Heute ist ein guter Tag.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No. Hoy es mi día libre.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tudo bem. Hoje é dia de descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่เป็นไร วันนี้พัก
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không được. Hôm nay là ngày xui xẻo.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: If you're sure you're fine, we can continue...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 大丈夫なら続けるけど…
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 如果没问题的话就继续训练…
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 如果沒問題的話就繼續訓練…
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wenn das Training vorbei ist, wird das Training fortgesetzt, aber...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Si no funciona, el entrenamiento continuará, pero...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Se você não se importar, o treinamento continuará...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ถ้าทำได้ การฝึกฝนก็จะดำเนินต่อไป...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Jika tidak berhasil, latihan akan terus berlanjut...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Nếu ổn thì việc huấn luyện sẽ tiếp tục, nhưng...
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: अगर तुम ठीक हो, तो हम जारी रख सकते हैं...

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je donne le potion de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le entrego una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Estou passando a poção de cura.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ส่งต่อการใช้พลัง

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングを切り上げ、休息をとることにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng luyện tập và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN:
休むことにしたが、
<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'il/elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfait(e).
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien noch eine gewisse Unzufriedenheit zu bestehen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih tampak tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mặc dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再びトレーニングに挑み、見事な成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retenté l'entraînement et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente o treino e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại và đạt được kết quả khả quan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再びトレーニングに挑んだが、失敗してしまった。
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat sich erneut dem Training gestellt, aber ist gescheitert.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Lo intenté de nuevo, pero fallé.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Eu tentei treinar de novo, mas falhei.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองอีกครั้ง แต่ก็ล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Aku mencoba latihan lagi tapi gagal.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại thử thách bản thân nhưng thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से प्रशिक्षण में चुनौती दी, लेकिन असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> reluctantly smiled after receiving the ginseng-flavored potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN:
<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は黒酢味のポーションを受け取り、
何とも言えない表情で喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>收到红参口味药水，表情复杂地开心着。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>收到紅蔘口味藥水，表情複雜地開心著。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a reçu la potion au goût de ginseng et a souri à contrecœur.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lächelte widerwillig nach Erhalt des Rotginseng-Tranks.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras recibir la poción con sabor a ginseng, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sonrió con una alegría un tanto forzada.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recebeu a Poção de Ginseng e sorriu relutantemente.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้รับยาโพชั่นรสโสมและดีใจอย่างเต็มใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menerima ramuan rasa ginseng merah dengan senang hati yang getir.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> miễn cưỡng mỉm cười sau khi nhận lọ thuốc vị hồng sâm.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने जिनसेंग-स्वाद वाली औषधि प्राप्त करने के बाद अनिच्छा से खुशी व्यक्त की।
